question: A is the only PRODUCTION constraint in the v4 pool; B and every reference, registered or candidate, is a budget. So a positive Delta_R is equally consistent with 'A is unusually damaging to B' and with 'a production constraint is damaging to a budget outcome, and A is the only one available'. The lower-bound families are the only candidates that share A's class. Does one of them clear §13.2 on the calibration set, so that the class-matched contrast D(B<-A) against D(B<-CL) becomes estimable?
status: NON-CONFIRMATORY DESIGN SCREEN, fourth arm. Not a registered §12.3 record. Amendment B's recommended set is unchanged and nothing here is adopted.
why_amendment_B_set_it_aside: Amendment B §6: a lower bound imposes a length FLOOR, pushing length up while B pushes it down. That objection was written for the current stem. Under the floored stem the stem already imposes a length floor on every cell, so the mirror-image confound is weaker; this arm measures it rather than assuming either way.
